reference_note: Delegated mileage/time and takeover-rate cutoffs ('规定里程或者时间', '人工接管率符合规定值') are listed as one item per article (value set by other rules); a version matches if it records the article's delegated cutoff in either variable. Procedural deadlines and retention periods (Art. 26, 27) are not listed as thresholds or key dates.

reference.quote: 按照有关规定经过有驾驶人智能网联汽车道路测试并达到规定里程或者时间，且未发生交通违法行为以及因车辆原因造成的安全事故，人工接管率符合规定值。

reference.quote: 开展高风险道路测试的，应当经过规定里程或者时间的低风险道路测试，且未发生严重交通违法行为以及因车辆原因造成的安全事故，人工接管率符合规定值。

reference.quote: 申请安全性自我声明确认的车辆应当经过规定里程或者时间的道路测试，且未发生交通违法行为以及因车辆原因造成的安全事故，人工接管率符合规定值。
reference.value: road-testing mileage or time >= prescribed value; takeover rate within prescribed value (set by other rules); eligibility for demonstration application

reference.quote: 经过规定里程或者时间的示范应用，且未发生交通违法行为以及因车辆原因造成的安全事故，人工接管率符合规定值。

reference.value: mileage or time >= prescribed value; takeover rate within prescribed value (set by other rules); eligibility for batch confirmation of same-model vehicles

reference.value: >= 3 serious road traffic violations (vehicle): termination of the vehicle or same-model vehicles
